activeIndex.zh-CN: 当前展示的索引，可用 `bind:activeIndex` 绑定；传 undefined 时交还控制权，从最后一次受控的索引继续。
activeIndex.en-US: Index of the slide being shown; bind it with `bind:activeIndex`. Passing undefined hands control back, continuing from the last controlled index.

animation.zh-CN: 切换动画，可选 slide 或 fade。

arrowProps.zh-CN: 上一项、下一项箭头按钮的数据，`leftArrow.props`、`rightArrow.props` 放按钮属性；`onclick` 与 `class` 会和内置处理、内置类名合并。图标使用 `leftArrow`、`rightArrow` snippet。
arrowProps.en-US: Data for the previous and next arrow buttons: `leftArrow.props` and `rightArrow.props` hold the button attributes. `onclick` and `class` are merged with the built-in handler and classes. Use the `leftArrow` and `rightArrow` snippets for the icons.

arrowType.zh-CN: 箭头展示时机，可选 always 或 hover。
arrowType.en-US: When the arrows are shown: always or hover.

autoPlay.zh-CN: 是否自动循环播放，也可传入 interval（切换间隔，默认 2000 毫秒）和 hoverToPause（悬浮时是否暂停，默认 true）。
autoPlay.en-US: Whether to play automatically, or an object with interval (milliseconds between slides, default 2000) and hoverToPause (pause while hovered, default true).

indicatorPosition.zh-CN: 指示器位置，可选 left、center 或 right。
indicatorPosition.en-US: Indicator position: left, center or right.

indicatorSize.zh-CN: 指示器尺寸，可选 small 或 medium。

indicatorType.zh-CN: 指示器类型，可选 dot、line 或 columnar。
indicatorType.en-US: Indicator type: dot, line or columnar.

items.zh-CN: 幻灯片的数据，每项一张，由 `slide` snippet 渲染；数据量决定幻灯片数，首次渲染前就已知。
items.en-US: Data for the slides, one per item, rendered by the `slide` snippet; the count is known before the first render.

leftArrow.zh-CN: 上一项箭头图标的 snippet；传入空 snippet 时按钮内容为空。
leftArrow.en-US: Snippet for the icon of the previous arrow. An empty snippet leaves the button empty.

onChange.zh-CN: 切换到新的一项时调用，参数为新索引和上一个索引。
onChange.en-US: Called when the shown slide changes, with the new index and the previous index.

onfocusin.zh-CN: 焦点进入轮播时调用；同时暂停自动播放。
onfocusin.en-US: Called when focus enters the carousel; autoplay pauses as well.

onfocusout.zh-CN: 焦点离开轮播时调用；同时恢复自动播放。
onfocusout.en-US: Called when focus leaves the carousel; autoplay resumes as well.

onmouseenter.zh-CN: 指针进入轮播时调用；`hoverToPause` 为 true 时同时暂停自动播放。
onmouseenter.en-US: Called when the pointer enters the carousel; with `hoverToPause` autoplay pauses as well.

onmouseleave.zh-CN: 指针离开轮播时调用；同时恢复自动播放。
onmouseleave.en-US: Called when the pointer leaves the carousel; autoplay resumes as well.

rightArrow.zh-CN: 下一项箭头图标的 snippet；传入空 snippet 时按钮内容为空。
rightArrow.en-US: Snippet for the icon of the next arrow. An empty snippet leaves the button empty.

slide.zh-CN: 一张幻灯片内容的 snippet，参数为 `{ item, index }`；Carousel 给每张包一层带样式类、role 与 `inert` 的元素。
slide.en-US: Snippet for the content of one slide, with the parameter `{ item, index }`; the carousel wraps each slide in an element carrying the classes, role and `inert`.

slideDirection.zh-CN: 动画为 slide 时的滑动方向，可选 left 或 right。
slideDirection.en-US: Slide direction when the animation is slide: left or right.

theme.zh-CN: 指示器和箭头的主题，可选 primary、light 或 dark。
theme.en-US: Theme of the indicator and arrows: primary, light or dark.

trigger.zh-CN: 指示器触发切换的时机，可选 click 或 hover。
trigger.en-US: How the indicator switches slides: click or hover.

goTo.zh-CN: 切换到指定索引，超出范围时循环。
goTo.en-US: Goes to the given index; an out-of-range index wraps around.

play.zh-CN: 开始自动播放，autoPlay 为 false 时同样生效。
play.en-US: Starts autoplay, even when autoPlay is off.
